missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics (latency, saturation, connection count) for the inventory dependency
Inventory service logs confirming Redis connection/timeout errors
Order service dependency operation metrics for inventory calls
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout and 502, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show Redis timeouts but no Redis-side telemetry to confirm whether the cause is Redis saturation, network, or inventory client config.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ~2s ReadTimeouts on order->inventory calls and redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in traces; topology confirms inventory->redis. Redis timeout is the best-supported bounded candidate; Redis-side evidence is still needed to confirm the underlying mechanism.
